title: Gaunt–Merkle conjectured bounds for the median of the variance-gamma distribution
statement:
Let $X\sim\mathrm{VG}(r,\theta,\sigma,\mu)$ with $r,\theta,\sigma>0$, and let $\mathrm{Med}(X)$ denote its median. The parameters $r$, $\theta$, $\sigma$, and $\mu$ are the shape, skewness, scale, and location parameters, respectively.

**Gaunt–Merkle median bounds conjecture.** For $r>0$,

$$
\mu+(r-1)\theta<\mathrm{Med}(X)<\mu+r\theta \mathrm{e}^{-2/3r}<\mu+\left(r-\frac{2}{3}+\frac{2}{9r}\right)\theta,
$$

and, for $r\geq 2$,

$$
\mathrm{Med}(X)\leq\mu+(r+2\log 2-2)\theta.
$$

Exact median formulas are available for some parameter values, but no general closed-form formula is known. The conjectured bounds are supported by numerical results, while accurate general bounds for the median remain unresolved.
references:
**2 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2021–2023). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:2106.02897](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.02897).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.05615

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of March 2023).
source_name: Adrian Fischer, Robert E. Gaunt and Andrey Sarantsev, “The Variance-Gamma Distribution: A Review”, arXiv:2303.05615 (2023).
